mapper.select: SELECT sp.ent_ceo_no AS entCeoNo, p.products_nm AS productName, pc.small_category AS cateName, p.products_status AS productStatus, q.quantity AS quantity FROM sell_products sp JOIN products p ON sp.products_no = p.products_no JOIN products_category pc ON p.product_category_no = pc.product_category_no JOIN quantity q ON sp.products_no = q.products_no AND sp.ent_ceo_no = q.ent_ceo_no GROUP BY sp.ent_ceo_no, p.products_no;

SELECT s.sell_products_no AS sellProductsNo, p.products_nm AS productName, s.margin_ratio_no AS marginRatioNo, m.model_nm AS modelName, s.ent_ceo_no AS entCeoNo, s.ent_emp_id AS entEmpId, s.products_no AS productsNo, s.lump_sum_pay_price AS lumpSumPayPrice, s.period AS period, s.calculate_price AS calculatePrice, s.final_price AS finalPrice, DATE_FORMAT(s.register_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS registerDate, DATE_FORMAT(s.revision_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS revisionDate, s.use_status AS useStatus, IFNULL(f.file_path, '/manage/assets/imgs/theme/upload.svg') AS productImage FROM sell_products s LEFT JOIN products p ON s.products_no = p.products_no LEFT JOIN files f ON f.ref_id = p.model_no AND f.file_type = 'mainImage' JOIN model m ON p.model_no = m.model_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sell_product ( sell_products_no, margin_ratio_no, ent_ceo_no, ent_emp_id, products_no, lump_sum_pay_price, period, calculate_price, final_price, register_date, revision_date, use_status ) VALUES ( #{sellProductsNo}, #{marginRatioNo}, #{entCeoNo}, #{entEmpId}, #{productsNo}, #{lumpSumPayPrice}, #{period}, #{calculatePrice}, #{finalPrice}, #{registerDate}, #{revisionDate}, #{useStatus} )
